whenToUse: A consumer mobile app landing (fitness, habits, lifestyle) with phone mockups, plans, reviews and store download.
Apps that want a scroll-driven feature walkthrough.
avoidWhen: A fintech or corporate app — use site-app-02.
A pre-launch app collecting sign-ups — use site-waitlist-01.
a11y: Includes a skip link; the scroll-driven phone falls back to static screens under prefers-reduced-motion.
Phone illustrations are role="img" — give them labels that describe the screen.
